branches.title: Structured-extraction and downstream decision-equivalence evaluations

branches.expected_comparison: Schema/exact/field/epistemic extraction plus downstream and urgent-action equivalence

branches.expected_comparison: Paired before-and-after qualification of the admitted base combination and exact post-training deployment artifact
